decks.notes: The main focus of this Gruul Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. The deck aims to have a strong early game presence with cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Burning-Tree Emissary, while also utilizing pump spells like Monstrous Rage to push through damage. Atarka's Command and Ramunap Ruins provide additional reach to finish off opponents. The deck also includes utility lands like Den of the Bugbear for late-game advantage. Overall, the strategy is to maintain pressure and finish off the opponent quickly.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent with a combination of powerful creatures and removal spells. By combining efficient threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodtithe Harvester with disruption like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and disrupt their game plan. The mana base is tailored to support a consistent aggressive strategy, with a mix of lands that enable both early plays and late-game powerhouses. Overall, the deck thrives on maintaining pressure and disrupting the opponent's game plan to secure victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan with targeted removal and discard spells. The deck also utilizes powerful legendary creatures like Magda, Brazen Outlaw and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to apply pressure on the opponent. By efficiently managing resources and applying constant pressure on the opponent, this deck aims to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize or mount a defense.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also utilizing removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to control the board. The deck aims to apply pressure early with aggressive creatures such as Bloodtithe Harvester and Mutavault, and finish off the opponent with powerful cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Blade of the Oni. The deck also has strong mana fixing with cards like Blightstep Pathway and Blackcleave Cliffs to ensure a consistent mana base for its aggressive plays.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while playing efficient threats like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Spyglass Siren to apply pressure, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can establish their own board presence. By balancing disruptive elements with aggressive creatures, this deck aims to control the tempo of the game and secure a victory through a combination of disruption and aggro tactics.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent through discard spells like Thoughtseize and Liliana of the Veil, along with removal spells such as Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. Waste Not provides value from opponent discard, while Stormchaser's Talent and This Town Ain't Big Enough generate card advantage. The win condition comes from The Meathook Massacre and Hopeless Nightmare, supported by card advantage engines like Castle Locthwain and Geier Reach Sanitarium. The mana base supports a balance between black and blue sources, with additional utility lands like Hive of the Eye Tyrant and Gloomlake Verge.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays to overwhelm opponents quickly. It utilizes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to disrupt opponents' strategies while deploying powerful threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck also includes cards like Fear of Missing Out and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to maintain pressure on opponents. With a solid mana base and a mix of creatures and spells, this deck aims to win the game as fast as possible by attacking relentlessly and punishing opponents for falling behind.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on deploying efficient threats early on with cards like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, supported by disruptive creatures such as Thalia, Guardian of Thraben. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Archon of Emeria. Collected Company helps to refill the board with more threats, while Skyclave Apparition and Knight of Autumn provide removal and flexibility. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while conserving resources to close out the game efficiently.

This aggro deck focuses on quickly enhancing artifacts and creatures to deal damage efficiently. With cards like Ensoul Artifact and Shrapnel Blast, the deck aims to create powerful threats early on. Protection is provided with spells like Sheltered by Ghosts and counters like Spell Pierce. The deck includes a mix of aggressive creatures like Voldaren Epicure and Gleaming Geardrake, along with utility creatures like Thraben Inspector. The mana base is designed to support the colored requirements of the deck while also providing flexibility in casting spells.

The main concept of this Gruul Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent by playing aggressive creatures and using powerful instant spells to remove threats or deal direct damage. The deck relies on a combination of efficient creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Soul-Scar Mage, along with spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage to control the board and pressure the opponent. The deck also includes some protection spells like Snakeskin Veil and Monstrous Rage to keep key creatures alive. Overall, the goal is to establish a strong board presence and quickly finish off the opponent.

The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with aggressive creatures and utilizing burn spells to control the opponent's board. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Heartfire Hero, while also having access to removal spells like Reckless Rage and Burst Lightning to deal with threats. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while also having the flexibility to adapt to different board states with cards like Snakeskin Veil and Soul-Scar Mage.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on playing aggressively with efficient creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Skyclave Apparition while disrupting opponents with cards like Archon of Emeria and Aven Interrupter. The deck also includes mana acceleration with Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves to quickly cast powerful spells like Collected Company. With a mix of creatures and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents early and maintain pressure throughout the game.

The primary strategy of this deck is to utilize Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful card advantage engine, allowing the player to access a wide array of multicolored spells. The deck includes cards with various effects, such as removal spells like Abrupt Decay and Lightning Helix, ramp spells like Up the Beanstalk and Omnath, Locus of Creation, and versatile spells like Bring to Light. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional value through blinking permanents. Overall, the deck aims to control the game with a mix of removal, card advantage, and versatile threats.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize creatures with high devotion to green in order to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By focusing on green mana symbols in the casting cost of creatures like Abhorrent Oculus and Old-Growth Troll, this deck aims to generate large amounts of mana with Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to cast powerful spells like Collected Company and activate abilities like Tyvar, the Pummeler's pump ability. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Voice of Resurgence and Extraction Specialist to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on a control strategy with a heavy emphasis on removal spells and disruption to control the game while generating card advantage. It also makes use of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion to provide additional value and flexibility. The deck features a mix of creature removal, hand disruption, and card draw to handle a variety of threats, and includes a mix of creatures and enchantments to provide a win condition and board presence. The mana base is designed to support the deck's colors and ensure consistency in casting spells.

The deck focuses on a fast-paced aggressive strategy centered around creature and spell synergy in order to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Utilizing cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Mutavault, the deck aims to apply pressure early on and maintain a steady stream of threats throughout the game. Thoughtseize and Duress help to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodtithe Harvester provide powerful finishers to close out the game. Rakdos Aggro excels at controlling the board and capitalizing on tempo swings to secure victory.
